title: Repair imported KiCad boards only inside a sandbox
rootCause: BoardForge needed proof that an uploaded or imported board could be physically repaired without mutating the user's original project.
fix: Copy the source KiCad project into a BoardForge sandbox, hash the source before and after, run dirty-to-clean repair only in the sandbox, and promote only the sandbox repair candidate when DRC/ERC/unconnected/shorts are clean.
